units.source_en: Why had he rejected his brother’s well-meant advice, disregarded his uncle’s honor and the goodwill of all his kinsmen and friends, and resolutely entered this place of peril?
units.source_zh: 他拂逆兄长善言，不顾叔父的体面及诸亲友的好意，毅然入危地，究竟是为了什么？

paragraphs.source_zh: 至少，幸村并非为了俗人眼中的出人头地，方下九度山。若是为了荣华富贵，他只要听从兄长和松仓丰后守的劝诫，服侍家康即可。他拂逆兄长善言，不顾叔父的体面及诸亲友的好意，毅然入危地，究竟是为了什么？

paragraphs.source_en: After returning to camp that day, Yukimura ordered even stricter precautions than before, then withdrew into solitary contemplation.

units.source_en: After returning to camp that day, Yukimura ordered even stricter precautions than before, then withdrew into solitary contemplation.
units.source_zh: 当日回营之后，幸村下令要比先前更严加防范，然后，他便独自沉思起来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 当日回营之后，幸村下令要比先前更严加防范，然后，他便独自沉思起来。

paragraphs.source_en: Daisuke was deeply dissatisfied with his father’s conduct in the great hall. After hearing the order to tighten the defenses, he deliberately berated the men in a loud voice, declaring that “the war is far from over,” and stormed out of the command tent.

units.source_en: Daisuke was deeply dissatisfied with his father’s conduct in the great hall. After hearing the order to tighten the defenses, he deliberately berated the men in a loud voice, declaring that “the war is far from over,” and stormed out of the command tent.
units.source_zh: 大助对父亲在大厅的表现甚是不满，听到父亲严加防范的命令后，他一面故意大声训斥部下，说“战争还远未结束”，一面愤愤出了大帐。

paragraphs.source_zh: 大助对父亲在大厅的表现甚是不满，听到父亲严加防范的命令后，他一面故意大声训斥部下，说“战争还远未结束”，一面愤愤出了大帐。

paragraphs.source_en: It was already dusk when word came that the sworn declarations had been exchanged.

units.source_en: It was already dusk when word came that the sworn declarations had been exchanged.
units.source_zh: 交换誓书的消息传来时，已是黄昏时分了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 交换誓书的消息传来时，已是黄昏时分了。

paragraphs.source_en: A rumor spread widely that on this day Kimura Shigenari had gone to the Tokugawa camp to exchange sworn declarations and made Ieyasu press a bloody handprint upon one. In fact, Shigenari’s mission had been to Hidetada’s headquarters; those who went to Ieyasu’s headquarters were emissaries of Uraku and Harunaga.

units.source_en: A rumor spread widely that on this day Kimura Shigenari had gone to the Tokugawa camp to exchange sworn declarations and made Ieyasu press a bloody handprint upon one.
units.source_zh: 坊间都在盛传，这一日，木村重成赶赴德川大营交取誓书，让家康在上边按血手印。

units.source_en: In fact, Shigenari’s mission had been to Hidetada’s headquarters; those who went to Ieyasu’s headquarters were emissaries of Uraku and Harunaga.
units.source_zh: 实际上，木村重成出使的乃是秀忠本阵，到家康本阵去的，为有乐和治长的使者。

paragraphs.source_zh: 坊间都在盛传，这一日，木村重成赶赴德川大营交取誓书，让家康在上边按血手印。实际上，木村重成出使的乃是秀忠本阵，到家康本阵去的，为有乐和治长的使者。

paragraphs.source_en: Yukimura nodded silently as he gazed upon the river and streets bathed in the setting sun. “There were so many warships on the river, yet their numbers have suddenly dwindled.”

units.source_en: Yukimura nodded silently as he gazed upon the river and streets bathed in the setting sun. “There were so many warships on the river, yet their numbers have suddenly dwindled.”
units.source_zh: 幸村默默点着头，看着洒满夕阳的河川和街市，道：“河面上原本有偌多军船，也一下子减少了。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 幸村默默点着头，看着洒满夕阳的河川和街市，道：“河面上原本有偌多军船，也一下子减少了。”

paragraphs.source_en: Igi Shichirōemon still had not noticed the change in Yukimura’s expression. From about this moment onward, Yukimura’s gaze grew steadily more fearsome.

units.source_en: Igi Shichirōemon still had not noticed the change in Yukimura’s expression.
units.source_zh: 伊木七郎右卫门仍未察觉到幸村表情的变化。

units.source_en: From about this moment onward, Yukimura’s gaze grew steadily more fearsome.
units.source_zh: 大约从此时起，幸村的目光变得越来越可怕。

paragraphs.source_zh: 伊木七郎右卫门仍未察觉到幸村表情的变化。大约从此时起，幸村的目光变得越来越可怕。

paragraphs.source_en: Shichirōemon started. “Then the withdrawal of the warships is a trick?”

units.source_en: Shichirōemon started. “Then the withdrawal of the warships is a trick?”
units.source_zh: 七郎右卫门一愣，“这么说，让军船撤去乃是有诈？”

paragraphs.source_zh: 七郎右卫门一愣，“这么说，让军船撤去乃是有诈？”

paragraphs.source_en: Yukimura said nothing. He nodded with proud assurance and went straight down from the watchtower. He hurried back to his camp, threw his cherished cloud-and-dragon battle surcoat over his armor, rushed from the command tent, and swung into the saddle.

units.source_en: Yukimura said nothing. He nodded with proud assurance and went straight down from the watchtower.

ja.t: とうなずくと、そのまま

units.source_zh: 幸村不言，傲然点了点头，径直下了瞭望塔。

units.source_en: He hurried back to his camp, threw his cherished cloud-and-dragon battle surcoat over his armor, rushed from the command tent, and swung into the saddle.
units.source_zh: 他急匆匆赶回营帐，把引以为豪的云龙阵羽织罩在盔甲外，奔出大帐，翻身上马。

paragraphs.source_zh: 幸村不言，傲然点了点头，径直下了瞭望塔。他急匆匆赶回营帐，把引以为豪的云龙阵羽织罩在盔甲外，奔出大帐，翻身上马。

paragraphs.source_en: Alarmed, Igi Shichirōemon ran down from the watchtower after him, but in the end had no chance to speak with Yukimura.

units.source_en: Alarmed, Igi Shichirōemon ran down from the watchtower after him, but in the end had no chance to speak with Yukimura.

ja.t: をかけることはできなかった。

units.source_zh: 伊木七郎右卫门一阵紧张，也跟着跑下瞭望塔，可终未能和幸村说上话。

paragraphs.source_zh: 伊木七郎右卫门一阵紧张，也跟着跑下瞭望塔，可终未能和幸村说上话。

paragraphs.source_en: “I leave the camp in your hands!” Yukimura shouted the words, spurred his horse, and made straight for the main castle.

units.source_en: “I leave the camp in your hands!”
units.source_zh: “留守就交给你了！”

units.source_en: Yukimura shouted the words, spurred his horse, and made straight for the main castle.
units.source_zh: 幸村大声说完，催马直奔本城。

paragraphs.source_zh: “留守就交给你了！”幸村大声说完，催马直奔本城。

paragraphs.source_en: At the main castle, in the camp of Kimura Nagato-no-kami Shigenari, a folding stool had already been set beside the watchfire because Daisuke had sent word ahead. Shigenari had not even changed out of the clothes he had worn to Hidetada’s camp and was waiting only for Yukimura’s arrival.

units.source_en: At the main castle, in the camp of Kimura Nagato-no-kami Shigenari, a folding stool had already been set beside the watchfire because Daisuke had sent word ahead. Shigenari had not even changed out of the clothes he had worn to Hidetada’s camp and was waiting only for Yukimura’s arrival.
units.source_zh: 本城木村长门守重成营中，由于大助事先通禀，篝火旁边已经安好折杌，重成连赴秀忠阵营时穿的衣服都未换下，只等着幸村前来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 本城木村长门守重成营中，由于大助事先通禀，篝火旁边已经安好折杌，重成连赴秀忠阵营时穿的衣服都未换下，只等着幸村前来。

paragraphs.source_en: Darkness had closed in on every side, and the flames were gradually deepening to red.

units.source_en: Darkness had closed in on every side, and the flames were gradually deepening to red.
units.source_zh: 四面已经暗了下来，火焰的颜色也逐渐变红。

paragraphs.source_zh: 四面已经暗了下来，火焰的颜色也逐渐变红。

paragraphs.source_en: “I heard that you had urgent business with me, so I slipped away from the Lord of the Right and came here.”

units.source_en: “I heard that you had urgent business with me, so I slipped away from the Lord of the Right and came here.”
units.source_zh: “听说大人有急事，我暗中离开右府，赶了过来。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “听说大人有急事，我暗中离开右府，赶了过来。”

paragraphs.source_en: Yukimura, unusually impassioned, dispensed even with his customary greetings. “Lord Nagato, there is one matter that Yukimura can discuss with you alone.”

units.source_en: Yukimura, unusually impassioned, dispensed even with his customary greetings. “Lord Nagato, there is one matter that Yukimura can discuss with you alone.”
units.source_zh: 幸村则显出一副少有的激昂之态，连一贯的寒暄都省了，“长门守大人，有一事，幸村只能和你商议。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 幸村则显出一副少有的激昂之态，连一贯的寒暄都省了，“长门守大人，有一事，幸村只能和你商议。”

paragraphs.source_en: “What matter can be so grave?”

units.source_en: “What matter can be so grave?”
units.source_zh: “究竟何事，如此郑重？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “究竟何事，如此郑重？”

paragraphs.source_en: “If Yukimura asked you to go to your death, would you consent?”

units.source_en: “If Yukimura asked you to go to your death, would you consent?”
units.source_zh: “幸村若让你赴死，你会答应否？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “幸村若让你赴死，你会答应否？”

paragraphs.source_en: For an instant, the handsome, slightly broad face of Kimura Nagato-no-kami Shigenari froze. “If it is Lord Sanada’s wish… then for the Toyotomi house and for the Lord of the Right, should the need arise, Shigenari will not shrink from his duty!”

units.source_en: For an instant, the handsome, slightly broad face of Kimura Nagato-no-kami Shigenari froze. “If it is Lord Sanada’s wish… then for the Toyotomi house and for the Lord of the Right, should the need arise, Shigenari will not shrink from his duty!”
units.source_zh: 一瞬间，木村长门守重成端正而略显宽阔的脸僵住，“既然是真田大人的意思……为了丰臣氏，为了右府，若有需要，重成义不容辞！”

paragraphs.source_zh: 一瞬间，木村长门守重成端正而略显宽阔的脸僵住，“既然是真田大人的意思……为了丰臣氏，为了右府，若有需要，重成义不容辞！”

paragraphs.source_en: “Hearing you say that sets Yukimura’s mind at ease. Lord Nagato, it must be tonight! Tonight is the crucial moment that will decide the fate of the Toyotomi house!”

units.source_en: “Hearing you say that sets Yukimura’s mind at ease.
units.source_zh: “既然你这么说，幸村就放心了。

units.source_en: Lord Nagato, it must be tonight!
units.source_zh: 长门守大人，就是今夜！

units.source_en: Tonight is the crucial moment that will decide the fate of the Toyotomi house!”
units.source_zh: 今夜，乃是决定丰臣氏命运的关键！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “既然你这么说，幸村就放心了。长门守大人，就是今夜！今夜，乃是决定丰臣氏命运的关键！”

paragraphs.source_en: Perhaps because Yukimura’s emotions were so fierce, after casting out that enigmatic declaration he found himself unable to continue and could only breathe heavily. The young Shigenari sat rigid. Never had he seen Yukimura like this, and he waited for him to continue.

units.source_en: Perhaps because Yukimura’s emotions were so fierce, after casting out that enigmatic declaration he found himself unable to continue and could only breathe heavily.

ja.t: げかけたあと、しばらく

units.source_zh: 许是幸村太激切的缘故，在抛出谜一般的一语之后，他一时竟说不出话来，只是喘着粗气。

units.source_en: The young Shigenari sat rigid. Never had he seen Yukimura like this, and he waited for him to continue.
units.source_zh: 年轻的重成僵在了那里，他从没见过幸村这副模样，他等待着下文。

paragraphs.source_zh: 许是幸村太激切的缘故，在抛出谜一般的一语之后，他一时竟说不出话来，只是喘着粗气。年轻的重成僵在了那里，他从没见过幸村这副模样，他等待着下文。

paragraphs.source_en: “Until now,” Yukimura said hoarsely, “we have yielded to the women’s appeals to affection and forgotten the true way a man should live.”

units.source_en: “Until now,” Yukimura said hoarsely, “we have yielded to the women’s appeals to affection and forgotten the true way a man should live.”
units.source_zh: “此前，”幸村声音沙哑，“我们输给了女人们的人情，忘记了男儿本来的活法。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “此前，”幸村声音沙哑，“我们输给了女人们的人情，忘记了男儿本来的活法。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Oh?”

units.source_en: “Oh?”

paragraphs.source_en: “The world of men is a field of carnage, Lord Nagato.”

units.source_en: “The world of men is a field of carnage, Lord Nagato.”
units.source_zh: “男子的世道即如修罗场，长门守大人。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “男子的世道即如修罗场，长门守大人。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Yes—cruel and unforgiving.”

units.source_en: “Yes—cruel and unforgiving.”
units.source_zh: “是，又残酷又苛刻。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “是，又残酷又苛刻。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Women live to bear and raise children; men die in order to kill. That nature has never changed from ancient times to this day. We must fight a battle of blood! Yet regrettably, so many have forgotten it.”

units.source_en: “Women live to bear and raise children; men die in order to kill.
units.source_zh: “女人乃是为生儿育女而活，男儿则是为了杀戮而死。

units.source_en: That nature has never changed from ancient times to this day.
units.source_zh: 此性从古至今从未改变。

units.source_en: We must fight a battle of blood!
units.source_zh: 我们必须血战！

units.source_en: Yet regrettably, so many have forgotten it.”
units.source_zh: 可惜，许多人竟把此忘了。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “女人乃是为生儿育女而活，男儿则是为了杀戮而死。此性从古至今从未改变。我们必须血战！可惜，许多人竟把此忘了。”

paragraphs.source_en: Shigenari’s eyes widened. “Then, Lord Sanada, you believe the sworn declarations exchanged during today’s mission merely express the women’s wishes and cannot be accepted—is that it?”

units.source_en: Shigenari’s eyes widened. “Then, Lord Sanada, you believe the sworn declarations exchanged during today’s mission merely express the women’s wishes and cannot be accepted—is that it?”
units.source_zh: 重成双眼圆瞪，“这么说，真田大人觉得今日出使所换的誓书，都是女人的意愿，不能承认，是吗？”

paragraphs.source_zh: 重成双眼圆瞪，“这么说，真田大人觉得今日出使所换的誓书，都是女人的意愿，不能承认，是吗？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Yes. On hearing those terms, the Lord of the Right finally breathed a sigh of relief. It seems the Retired Shogun truly has no desire to continue the war.”

units.source_en: “Yes.
On hearing those terms, the Lord of the Right finally breathed a sigh of relief. It seems the Retired Shogun truly has no desire to continue the war.”
units.source_zh: 听到这些，右府终于松了一口气，看来大御所真的毫无战意。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “是。听到这些，右府终于松了一口气，看来大御所真的毫无战意。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Set the Lord of the Right aside for now.” Yukimura stared fixedly at Shigenari. “The enemy, too, is rejoicing over the peace. Calm cooking smoke rises from every camp.”

units.source_en: “Set the Lord of the Right aside for now.”
units.source_zh: “先不管右府。”

units.source_en: Yukimura stared fixedly at Shigenari. “The enemy, too, is rejoicing over the peace. Calm cooking smoke rises from every camp.”
units.source_zh: 幸村直直盯住重成，“敌人也在为议和而快慰，无论哪一座营，都起了平静的炊烟。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “先不管右府。”幸村直直盯住重成，“敌人也在为议和而快慰，无论哪一座营，都起了平静的炊烟。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Tonight they are certain to drink their fill—in every camp…”

units.source_en: “Tonight they are certain to drink their fill—in every camp…”
units.source_zh: “今夜他们定会痛饮，每一营都……”

paragraphs.source_zh: “今夜他们定会痛饮，每一营都……”

paragraphs.source_en: “Then… then what Lord Sanada means is…”

units.source_en: “Then… then what Lord Sanada means is…”
units.source_zh: “那么……那么，真田大人的意思……”

paragraphs.source_zh: “那么……那么，真田大人的意思……”

paragraphs.source_en: “Hear Yukimura out first. The human mind has its limits. For the past day or two, the enemy has scarcely closed its eyes either. They have not eaten their fill for a long while, and with drink added besides, once they fall asleep they will be as good as dead.”

units.source_en: “Hear Yukimura out first.
units.source_zh: “先听幸村说。

units.source_en: The human mind has its limits.
units.source_zh: 人的心思有限。

units.source_en: For the past day or two, the enemy has scarcely closed its eyes either.
units.source_zh: 这一两日，敌人也几乎未合眼。

units.source_en: They have not eaten their fill for a long while, and with drink added besides, once they fall asleep they will be as good as dead.”
units.source_zh: 好久未饱食了，再加上饮酒，所以，一旦睡去，就形同死人。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “先听幸村说。人的心思有限。这一两日，敌人也几乎未合眼。好久未饱食了，再加上饮酒，所以，一旦睡去，就形同死人。”
